# dark-app-factory

> **"Software Factories for the Rest of Us."** A local-first, low-cost implementation of the
> Software Factory methodology (Spec -> Scenarios -> Agent Loop). Generates a working web
> application from a plain-text description using local Ollama models. Inspired by
> [StrongDM Factory](https://factory.strongdm.ai), which targets $1,000/dev/day in API
> tokens; this does the same methodology for roughly nothing.

Last updated: 2026-07-30 (v0.2.1-beta)

## Code map

```
factory.py        Pipeline orchestrator (zombie hunt, DTU lifecycle, phase sequencing)
foreman.py        Planner (enrich, plan, research, help, log)
worker.py         Execution engine (Specialist Council, reconciler, deep-crawl)
judge.py          Quality gate (port allocation, scenario execution, verdict)
run_manifest.py   Boot orchestrator (dependency install, ports, process-tree lifecycle)
dtu/main.py       Digital Twin Universe (mock external APIs)
src/specialists/  base.py (abstract Specialist), council.py (19 specialists)
src/utils/        logger, progress, ports, git_manager, help_oracle, stack_profile
src/verification/ scenario parser and executor, satisfaction scorer, rodney, ruffy, showboat
mcp-server/       FastMCP adapter for Claude Desktop and RoboFang
web_sota/         React + Vite + Tailwind dashboard
native/           Tauri wrapper and NSIS installer
```

## Configuration

- [.env.example](.env.example): Copy to `.env`. Models, ports, boot and install settings.
- [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml): Python project configuration and dependencies.
- [justfile](justfile): Task runner. Run `just` for the interactive command dashboard.
